description: Configure or publish the user’s public media kit at /@handle/media-kit (Pro). Live performance numbers and best posts come straight from Results on every visit; only the headline, intro, sponsor contact, period, visibility switches and optional audience or package rows are saved here. Ask the user before publishing.

about.description: Short introduction for sponsors, up to 400 characters. Leave empty to use the link page bio.

audience.description: Optional self-reported audience numbers, up to 8 rows, shown as self-reported since follower counts are not collected automatically.

count.description: Self-reported figure, e.g. "24.5K", up to 32 characters.

label.description: Audience line label, e.g. "Instagram followers", up to 60 characters.

brandId.description: The brand this is for, by its id from brands_list. Needed when the login has more than one brand; with one brand it can be left out.

contact.description: Sponsor contact link: an https:// page, mailto: email or tel: phone number, up to 500 characters. Leave empty to hide the contact button.

contactLabel.description: Words on the contact button, up to 40 characters. Defaults to "Get in touch".

days.description: Live results window to display: 30 or 90 days. Defaults to 30.

handle.description: Which of the user’s link page handles hosts the media kit. Leave out to use the blog page or first live link page.

headline.description: Headline at the top of the media kit, up to 120 characters. Leave empty to use the link page name.

packages.description: Optional sponsor offerings or rate rows, up to 6 items.

detail.description: What is included, up to 240 characters.

price.description: Rate or starting price, up to 40 characters.

published.description: true puts the media kit live at /@handle/media-kit; false takes it down. Ask the user before publishing.

showBestPosts.description: Show the top-performing posts from Results with links. Defaults to true.

showNetworks.description: Show the per-network performance table and connected accounts. Defaults to true.

showTopics.description: Show the brand’s topics and top hashtags. Defaults to true.

name: media_kit_save
title: Save the media kit
